content:
PlayerInteractEvent is fired when a player interacts with the world. This event has multiple subclasses for different interaction types.

All PlayerInteractEvent subclasses are fired on the NeoForge.EVENT_BUS and can be cancelled. Key subclasses include:
- RightClickBlock: Fired when player right-clicks a block
- LeftClickBlock: Fired when player left-clicks a block
- EntityInteract: Fired when player right-clicks an entity
- EntityInteractSpecific: Fired when player right-clicks a specific part of an entity

Use setCancellationResult() to control what happens when the event is cancelled.
